# PicoDrive call recorder: an example config file. See docs/32x-hooks.md, "Call recorder".
# The environment variable PICODRIVE_CALL_RECORDER names this file (record.bat sets it), and the core reads it when
# the game loads. A mistake turns the recorder off, with a message box listing each line that's wrong.
# '#' starts a comment. Numbers: hex as 0x... or $..., otherwise decimal.
# Every address below is a placeholder: put in your own.

# 1. Find the routines worth recording: count call targets, then read discover-m68k.txt and discover-sh2m.txt in the
#    output folder, busiest first (target, calls, distinct call sites). For the first <frames> frames of the window,
#    discover watches every instruction of that CPU, which is slower. Run it on its own first.
# discover <m68k|sh2m|sh2s> <frames>
#discover m68k 600
#discover sh2m 60

# 2. Record them: registers and regions at entry, and again when the routine returns.
# routine <m68k|sh2m|sh2s> <address> [name] [regions=label,...]
#   m68k: the main 68000, 24-bit addresses; once the 32X is on, cartridge code usually runs from the $880000 mirror.
#   sh2m, sh2s: the master and slave SH-2, the address as executed: 0x06... (cached) and 0x26... (cache-through) are
#   different aliases of SDRAM, 0x02... and 0x22... of the cartridge. Record the one the code runs from.
#   The name names the output file (default: cpu_address, e.g. m68k_00880ABC). Without regions=, every region.
routine m68k $880ABC  objects_update   regions=objects
routine m68k $881234  draw_list        regions=objects,sprites
routine sh2m 0x06004000 sh2_render     regions=commands
routine sh2s 0x06006000 sh2s_helper

# region <domain> <start> <length> <label>: memory captured at entry and at return. The domain is a BizHawk memory
# domain ("68K RAM", "32X RAM", "32X FB", "VRAM", "CRAM", "VSRAM", "Z80 RAM", "MD CART", "SRAM"), the start is an
# offset in it, and the bytes are as the domain shows them (the CPUs' big-endian order for RAM).
region 68K RAM 0xD000 0x1000 objects       # 68K RAM starts at $FF0000: this is $FFD000-$FFDFFF
region VRAM 0xF800 0x280 sprites           # the sprite table, if the game keeps it there
region 32X RAM 0x3F000 0x800 commands      # 32X RAM (SDRAM) is 0x06000000 on the SH-2s: this is 0x0603F000-0x0603F7FF
#region 68K RAM 0 0x10000 ram              # all of 68K RAM: 128 KB per call (entry and exit), mind maxcalls

# frames <first> <last>: record these frames only, inclusive. The first frame after power-on is 0; EmuHawk's frame
# counter shows the number of the next frame to run. Default: from frame 0 until the game is closed.
frames 300 1799

# maxcalls <n>: stop recording a routine after n calls (default 1000); index.json says which ones stopped.
maxcalls 1000

# out <folder>: where the files go, relative to this file (default: calls). Each time the core starts (loading the
# game, starting a movie, rebooting the core) the recorder starts over and overwrites the files there.
out calls
